description: This file defines a MarkdownRenderer class that converts JSONContent objects into Markdown strings, supporting various node types such as headings, lists, blockquotes, code blocks, images, and tables. It also exports a helper function to instantiate and use the renderer.

classes.name: MarkdownRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders JSONContent objects into Markdown formatted strings, supporting various markdown elements and node types.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Converts a JSONContent object into a Markdown string, joining nodes with an optional separator.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Dynamically renders a node based on its type by calling the corresponding method.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Extracts and concatenates text from a node and its children.

methods.name: content
methods.description: Renders the content of a node by processing its children.

methods.name: renderMark
methods.description: Applies markdown formatting to text based on its marks (bold, italic, underline, code, link).

methods.name: text
methods.description: Renders a text node, applying marks if present.

methods.name: heading
methods.description: Renders a heading node with appropriate number of '#' symbols based on level.

methods.name: bulletList
methods.description: Renders a bullet list from list item nodes.

methods.name: orderedList
methods.description: Renders an ordered list from list item nodes.

methods.name: blockquote
methods.description: Renders a blockquote by prefixing lines with '>'.

methods.name: codeBlock
methods.description: Renders a code block with optional language specification.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Renders an image with src and alt attributes.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Renders a table from tableRow nodes.
